lines.text: It asked for a regulator, separate from the AI Security Institute, with powers to require independent verification of safety claims.

lines.text: The same day the European Commission's chief scientific advisers asked Europe to build its own capacity to evaluate AI models.

matters.gist: Five cloud companies own most of the world's computing power for AI, and the US now requires a licence to rent large amounts of it abroad to firms from China and other embargoed countries.

lines.say: On the sixteenth of November the US Commerce Department issued a rule: data centres anywhere need a licence to give large amounts of AI compute to firms headquartered in China, Macau or other embargoed countries.

lines.text: The same rule requires licences for advanced chips sold to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, except to companies headquartered in the United States.
It states national security as its ground; it does not reach the compute a firm keeps for its own models.

matters.title: Ebola in Congo, still running
matters.gist: The Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Congo, the country's largest, has more than doubled in three months and still adds hundreds of cases a week.

lines.text: Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: 11,432 confirmed cases, including 5,593 deaths, on data to 15 November.
lines.say: Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: eleven thousand, four hundred and thirty-two confirmed cases, including five thousand, five hundred and ninety-three deaths, on data to the fifteenth of November.

lines.text: In the week to 15 November 442 cases were confirmed, against 458 the week before.
lines.say: In the week to the fifteenth of November four hundred and forty-two cases were confirmed, against four hundred and fifty-eight the week before.

lines.text: On 17 November WHO's chief said two thirds of confirmed deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centres.
lines.say: On the seventeenth of November the head of the World Health Organization said two thirds of confirmed deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centres.

lines.text: Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and a third of deaths.
Kenya's nine cases have all recovered or died, and its last patient left care on 11 November.
lines.say: Kenya's nine cases have all recovered or died, and its last patient left care on the eleventh of November.

matters.title: COP31 in its last days, on a 2.8-degree path
matters.gist: The climate summit in Antalya reaches its scheduled close with its main political text still in draft, while current policies still point to far more warming than the Paris goal.

lines.text: COP31 opened in Antalya, Türkiye, on 9 November 2026 and is set to close on 20 November.
lines.say: COP thirty-one opened in Antalya, Türkiye, on the ninth of November twenty twenty-six and is set to close on the twentieth of November.

lines.text: On 18 November divisions persisted over mitigation, carbon-market guidance and finance for adaptation and loss and damage, while a decision on the least developed countries was agreed.
lines.say: On the eighteenth of November divisions persisted over mitigation, carbon-market guidance and finance for adaptation and loss and damage, while a decision on the least developed countries was agreed.

lines.text: UNEP finds that current policies could take warming to 2.8°C this century.
lines.say: The UN Environment Programme finds that current policies could take warming to two point eight degrees this century.

lines.text: WMO puts January to September 2026 at about 1.47°C above pre-industrial.
lines.say: The World Meteorological Organization puts January to September twenty twenty-six at about one point four seven degrees above pre-industrial.
